title: Make ScheduleSpec's delayDays/daysOfWeek/rollingWindowSize getters exhaustive instead of using a `_` catch-all
why: EH-6 requires sealed-type switches to be exhaustive with no `default:`/`_` arm, precisely so the compiler forces every call site to be revisited when a new subtype is added. All three convenience getters on the sealed ScheduleSpec base class use `_ =>` to cover 'the other two variants' instead of naming them. The file's own docstring says a W3.27 migration to a single JSON `schedule` column is coming and will touch this exact codec — when that (or any future) change adds a 4th ScheduleSpec variant, these three getters will compile cleanly and silently return 0/null/null for it instead of forcing a compile error, which is exactly the failure mode sealed classes exist to prevent.
recommendation: Rewrite each getter with an explicit arm per subtype (e.g. `WeeklySchedule() => 0, RollingSchedule() => 0` instead of `_ => 0`) so adding a new variant breaks the build until these getters are updated.
acceptance_criteria: delayDays/daysOfWeek/rollingWindowSize each list DelaySchedule/WeeklySchedule/RollingSchedule explicitly with no `_`/`default` arm.

Once dart run custom_lint is fixed (already tracked separately), no_hardcoded_domain_term-style exhaustiveness stays enforced; until then, `dart analyze` continues to flag any genuinely non-exhaustive switch if a variant is later added without updating these getters.
